recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬細胞內吞噬了數個有核細胞（分葉或腎形核），細胞質中又散布大量約 2–3 µm 的小圓形紫色小體（LD 小體，Leishman-Donovan bodies），同時呈現噬血現象與利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體。
features: Large macrophage containing several engulfed nucleated cells (band/segmented granulocytes and other hematopoietic cells), indicating hemophagocytosis
Numerous small (about 2-3 um) round-to-oval dark purple bodies scattered in the macrophage cytoplasm and at its periphery
Tiny bodies consistent with amastigotes; nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast not clearly resolved at this magnification
Adjacent intermediate-sized mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and occasional myeloid precursors
Aspirate background with red cells; free extracellular amastigotes are possible along the cell edge
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage that has engulfed several nucleated hematopoietic cells, including granulocytes, consistent with hemophagocytosis. The macrophage cytoplasm contains numerous small, round-to-oval, dark-staining bodies approximately 2-3 um in size, consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies (amastigotes), although the kinetoplast is not clearly resolved at this magnification. Surrounding marrow cells include myeloid precursors and mononuclear cells. In a child with fever, massive splenomegaly and pancytopenia, findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis with secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo and budding and lack the rod-shaped kinetoplast of Leishmania amastigotes.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and no kinetoplast.
Superimposed platelets are larger, granular and lie out of the plane, whereas amastigotes are uniform, intracellular and have a nucleus plus kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Primary (familial) HLH or other infection-associated HLH
ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis alone is nonspecific; demonstration of intracellular amastigotes (or rK39 serology/PCR) identifies Leishmania as the trigger.
